about: sha256 of each sample city's city_model.json (citygen build output, M8a: M7b plus the fixes from the robustness sweep). The same bytes on every machine with the pinned requirements: M8a produced them on the M4 Mac (arm64 macOS) and confirmed them in the x86_64 Linux container; earlier milestones produced them on the cloud machine (x86_64 Linux) and confirmed them with GEOS 3.14.1 rebuilt with clang against libc++ (the C++ library of macOS builds) and with one worker and another PYTHONHASHSEED; traces of every stage are in docs/progress/M1b_det/ (M1b), docs/progress/M2/<city>/trace.json (M2), docs/progress/M3/<city>/trace.json (M3) and docs/progress/M3p/<city>/trace.json (M3p) docs/progress/M5/<city>/trace.json (M5) docs/progress/M6/<city>/trace.json (M6), docs/progress/M7/<city>/trace.json (M7a) docs/progress/M7b/<city>/trace.json (M7b) and docs/progress/M8a/<city>/trace.json (M8a; produced on the M4 Mac and confirmed byte for byte in the x86_64 Linux container citygen-x86). tests/test_roads.py asserts them on every run. blockout_plans: sha256 of each sample's blockout_plan.json (citygen blockout, M4), asserted by tests/test_blockout.py; the plan is the same bytes on every machine, Blender only draws it.

produced_on.confirmed_on: x86_64 Linux container citygen-x86 (same sha256 for all five and the pinned demo)
